scope: Post-hoc, exploratory second memory-capacity point on the exact same saved automatic Lean reads for seq8, seq11, seq20 and inset-excluded seq23. The sequences and prior 4096-token result have already been inspected; this is not held-out confirmation.
rationale: The prior 4096-of-5120 retention test removed little last-layer attention mass and produced little change. Test 1024 retained eligible historical tokens to assess stronger compression; this budget was chosen after observing the prior outcome and is not an optimized or preregistered generalization result.
intervention: For each frozen read retain exactly 1024 of 5120 verified eligible historical tokens; remove 4096. Do not alter conditioning memory, newest memory, all other memory, object pointers, position order or model parameters. Every selector uses the same key count and source state. Conditioning memory itself remains full at 4096 tokens. No frame or detector calls, target labels, new gates or thresholds enter inference.
controls: Reuse the previously verified trained prompt-conditioned, descriptor-independent and mismatched-descriptor channel scores, unweighted and RGB contrast, usage-only, distributed, foreground, three-region and shuffled contrast controls. The full-read no-op has more attention keys and is descriptive only. Retention uses original indexed RoPE spatial positions.
verification: Before priority reads, independently repeat a label-free seq3 gate. Verify retention and complement sizes, pointer and position preservation, no-op replay, captured feature and score provenance, equal attention counts, repeat both priority replays in fresh processes, independently reconstruct selected indices and rescore saved masks. Report present Dice, empty false alarms, overlaps and post-hoc attention mass removed. Do not claim full-video or patient-level results.
